Chapter 1159: Chapter 22: Nine Phoenixes and Shadow Demon (Request for Beginning-of-the-Month Guaranteed Monthly Votes)

Outside the battlefield.

The Chaos Venerables were intently watching from afar.

In the distance, the space-time had completely separated from the Xuanhuang Universe, forming its own realm, where the nine Chaos Great Saints were likely engaged in a fierce battle.

But as they watched.

The numerous venerables sensed something amiss.

Silence.

Too silent.

Logically, with the power of Chaos Great Saints, a clash would cause reverberations enough to bring down heaven and earth.

The battle between the newly advanced Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint unleashed such waves that entire natural universes prematurely collapsed into great destruction, forcing the Ancient Ming Venerable to move away preemptively or face severe injuries.

Such was the case with the two new Great Saints.

Not to mention the nine Great Saints among them, three belonging to the mighty Great Saints, where the likes of Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint were undoubtedly the weakest.

How could such a terrifying group of powerhouses battle each other so quietly? That piece of isolated space-time didn’t stir up even a bit of turmoil?

"Could it be that the nine Great Saints haven’t made a move?"

"Not making a move? Before a treasured object, won’t they act?"

"Indeed, the emerging treasured object is probably at the level of an unparalleled Great Saint, and for such a treasure, even an unparalleled Great Saint would find it hard to resist, let alone Chaos Great Saints?"

"If it weren’t for me going up there to die, I’d want to fight for it too."

...

The numerous Chaos Venerables bore odd expressions, for logically, they were sure the nine Great Saints would inevitably engage in a battle for supremacy.

Yet the current scene showed no signs of conflict, causing the Chaos Venerables to harbor deep doubts in their hearts.

"Let’s keep watching."

"What’s the rush."

One Chaos Venerable suggested, as they had no thoughts of claiming that treasured object, they would continue to observe.

...

What the numerous Chaos Venerables didn’t know was that it wasn’t that Dual Origin Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint hadn’t made a move, but that their power when they did was completely covered and enveloped by Lin Yuan’s outer universe, resulting in no aftermath spreading to the outside.

....

"Can’t escape?"

"The space-time is sealed, with my strength, I can’t tear open the Space-Time Passage to escape to the outside world."

Tian Lu Great Saint’s heart turned cold, upon seeing the scene where Dual Origin, Black Light, and Wild Barbarian Great Saints were immediately suppressed by Lin Yuan upon contact.

Tian Lu Great Saint realized that Dual Origin Great Saint was overly confident, or rather, underestimated Lin Yuan’s power.

Still resisting?

It’s uncertain whether one can survive, yet still resist?

At this moment, Tian Lu Great Saint began to regret, understanding that if he had immediately agreed when Lin Yuan asked them to leave the universe, nothing would have happened?

Insisted on joining forces with Dual Origin Great Saint.

"Hmm?"

While Lin Yuan dealt with Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and Wild Barbarian Great Saint, he also noticed the behavior of the other six Chaos Great Saints.

In fact, not just Tian Lu Great Saint, but Nine Phoenix Great Saint, Shadow Demon Great Saint, and other Chaos Great Saints, upon seeing the three mighty Chaos Great Saints so easily suppressed.

Their first thought was to flee.

And they acted on it, immediately scattering in several directions.

But unfortunately.

At this moment, the surrounding space-time had entirely succumbed to Lin Yuan’s outer universe.

Ordinary Chaos Great Saints couldn’t escape the constraints of space-time.

"Suppress."

Lin Yuan glanced at the six Chaos Great Saints fleeing in different directions, his mind focused, and the vast space-time surged forth, suppressing the six Chaos Great Saints in place without any resistance.

Like insects trapped in amber, they couldn’t move.

"It’s over."

Tian Lu Great Saint’s heart sank to the depths.

Even though he realized he would be suppressed once he couldn’t tear open the Space-Time Passage to the outside, the moment it truly arrived, Tian Lu Great Saint still felt heavy-hearted.

A dignified Chaos Great Saint, dominating various Void Domains, even when facing such mighty Great Saints as Dual Origin Great Saint, he never felt much fear, and now he was suppressed so easily.

"I am not dead."

Tian Lu Great Saint carefully examined his surroundings; although he was fully suppressed, he could still achieve basic perception.

"With the Galaxy Great Saint’s strength, having suppressed me, he could easily annihilate me, yet now I am not dead, which implies the Galaxy Great Saint doesn’t intend to kill me? Or perhaps I still have room for negotiation?"

Tian Lu Great Saint pondered to himself, if there was a chance, he naturally wouldn’t want to relinquish this physical body; cultivating a new primary battle body would require expending countless resources.

The more crucial point is that it would take a lot of time to cultivate.

Both resources and time would be needed.

Therefore, as long as there was a glimmer of hope, Tian Lu Great Saint was unwilling to let go of this physical body.

...

"Now I can deal with the three of them."

Having dealt with the six ordinary Chaos Great Saints, Lin Yuan finally focused on the three Great Saints: Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

It must be said, the strength of these three Great Saints was indeed formidable; even Lin Yuan, to completely suppress them as quickly as possible, utilized most of his techniques.

"Black Light Great Saint."

Lin Yuan looked towards Black Light Great Saint, surrounded by endless darkness, as the Black Light Domain around this Chaos Great Saint was rapidly being compressed.

"Tearing the Sky."

Lin Yuan suddenly lifted his right hand, and clawed at Black Light Great Saint.

In an instant, five trails filled with destructive aura flashed by, landing on the Black Light Domain surrounding Black Light Great Saint.

Immediately, the Black Light Domain began to rapidly collapse; after the second layer of ’Infinite Void,’ Lin Yuan’s foundational strength had significantly improved, and the ’Tearing the Sky’ Divine Skills, which depended on Lin Yuan’s foundation, naturally also escalated.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

Black Light Great Saint’s body was pierced through with one grab, the wound constantly exuding a destructive aura, extinguishing all vitality and recovery power.

"This?"

Black Light Great Saint widened his eyes, feeling his strength drastically decline due to that grab.

"Another grab."

Lin Yuan continued to unleash the ’Tearing the Sky’ Divine Skills.

Black Light Great Saint’s body was penetrated once more, causing the Black Light Domain surrounding him to fully collapse, eventually revealing Black Light Great Saint’s form.

Without the protection of the Black Light Domain, the Black Light Great Saint was like undefended prey before Lin Yuan, directly suppressed by the immense Power of Space-Time.

"Wild Barbarian Great Saint."

Lin Yuan looked at another Chaos Great Saint.

This Chaos Great Saint, though not as troublesome as the Black Light Great Saint, was still not easy to completely suppress.

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s physical body was incredibly strong, even surpassing the former Tuolong Great Saint. He had few means, but his survival ability was extremely high because he simply couldn’t die.

However, under the constant suppression of Lin Yuan’s external universe, coupled with the pure offensive Divine Skills known as ’Tear Heaven’, the Wild Barbarian Great Saint only lasted for a few dozen breaths before being swiftly suppressed by Lin Yuan, just like the Black Light Great Saint.

"Dual Origin Great Saint."

Lin Yuan looked at the last Great Saint.

Among the nine Chaos Great Saints, the Dual Origin Great Saint was definitely the most difficult to deal with, so Lin Yuan saved him for last.

"Galaxy Great Sage, I admit you are strong, but to suppress me like the Black Light? Absolutely impossible."

The Dual Origin Great Saint showed a trace of madness, his form suddenly boiling in shades of green and gray, unleashing a desperate attack, instantly tearing open a narrow rift on the space-time barriers leading to the outside world.

Buzz.

In an instant, the Dual Origin Great Saint escaped through this tiny rift.

Lin Yuan watched silently.

His external universe was indeed terrifying, but the Chaos evolutionary power mastered by the Dual Origin Great Saint was most adept at destroying space-time.

Tearing open the space-time leading to Lin Yuan was very difficult, but in a desperate situation, tearing a rift to the outside world was possible.

Swoosh.

The Dual Origin Great Saint escaped to the outside and immediately shuttled toward the entrance, while his voice transmitted to Lin Yuan through space-time:

"Galaxy Great Sage, I admit defeat this time, and will leave this universe immediately, never to approach within ten thousand Cosmic Eras, I swear..."

"Hmm?" Lin Yuan pondered upon hearing this, and his initial intention to pursue and kill was suppressed.

Although the Dual Origin Great Saint could barely escape, Lin Yuan could also pursue and kill.

It was precisely because of this that the Dual Origin Great Saint immediately succumbed and swore after escaping.

"Dark Sky Heart?"

Glancing behind him, Lin Yuan noted that the Dark Sky Palace had already emerged, and chasing the Dual Origin Great Saint might lead to other changes.

...

Lin Yuan stood silently, flipping his right hand.

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, Tian Lu Great Saint, and the other eight Chaos Great Saints appeared not far away.

At this moment, these eight Chaos Great Saints were completely suppressed, without any power to resist.

"Galaxy Great Sage."

The Black Light Great Saint steadied himself and respectfully asked Lin Yuan, "What price must I pay for you to let me go?"

Since Lin Yuan hadn’t extinguished him immediately, he must have other plans in mind.

"What price are you willing to pay?" Lin Yuan asked the Chaos Great Saints with interest.

For Lin Yuan, the most profitable approach was to exchange the main battle bodies of these Chaos Great Saints for more resources and treasures.

Directly killing? That would only yield bodily essence, but if it were an exchange? The conditions could be higher.

In any case, even if these Chaos Great Saints were killed, they would have survival measures to be resurrected, so using this for an exchange was what Lin Yuan intended to do.

"One billion cosmic stones."

The Black Light Great Saint thought for a moment and tentatively offered.

"Ten billion cosmic stones." Lin Yuan shook his head and looked at the Wild Barbarian Great Saint, "You too, if you want me to let you go, gather ten billion cosmic stones and deliver them."

"And you." Lin Yuan looked at Tian Lu Great Saint and the other Great Saints, "Each with five billion cosmic stones."

"Five billion cosmic stones?" Tian Lu Great Saint trembled, for a Chaos Great Saint like him, five billion cosmic stones was an immense sum.

"As for you two..." Lin Yuan’s gaze fell on Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint.

"Galaxy Great Sage..." Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint immediately responded to Lin Yuan.

At this moment, Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint were already prepared to be extorted. Unlike other senior Chaos Great Saints, they only had one main battle body.

If they lost it, they wouldn’t be able to show their face until fully restored, having no ability to protect themselves.

So as long as Lin Yuan’s price was not excessively high, Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint were prepared to agree first.

"I’ve heard about your grievances, continually battling since reaching the perfection of the Chaos Realm." Lin Yuan looked down at Nine Phoenix and Shadow Demon, speaking.

"Galaxy Great Sage, Shadow Demon once..." Nine Phoenix Great Saint immediately began to explain.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded and suddenly asked, "But have you considered that because of your battle shockwaves, numerous beings in one prematurely collapsing universe after another were affected?"

"The beings within the universe?"

Nine Phoenix and Shadow Demon were somewhat stunned, not expecting Lin Yuan to ask such a question.

"Those ants... dead are dead, what does it matter?" Shadow Demon Great Saint responded.

Nine Phoenix Great Saint said nothing, but clearly agreed with Shadow Demon Great Saint’s view.

"Fair enough."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He didn’t continue speaking.

A moment later.

Shadow Demon Great Saint tentatively asked, "Galaxy Great Sage, then what price do we need to pay..."

Before Shadow Demon Great Saint could finish, Lin Yuan glanced at him, "Noisy."

The next moment.

The bodies and souls of Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint began to rapidly disintegrate into dust.

Within just a few breaths.

The two Chaos Great Saints were completely obliterated.

"Galaxy Great Sage... this..." Tian Lu Great Saint and other Chaos Great Saints trembled upon witnessing this scene.

"It’s nothing." Lin Yuan shook his head.

"These two ants, dead are dead, what does it matter?"
